archetypes.name: dyn-skill-contract
archetypes.rationale: Prose-only skill contract refactor relies on pinned literals and pointer/load-contract distinction.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Verbosity Control sections and the new shared anchor for contract drift. Verify the shared pointer stays lightweight, skill-specific output categories remain local, and the /design Step 3 post-notification load contract remains intact. Focus on wording that could change orchestrator behavior despite no code changes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
